hook: The farmer who photographed five thousand snowflakes.

beats.say: In 1885, Vermont farm boy Wilson Bentley bolted a camera to his mother's microscope and caught the first photograph of a snow crystal.
He spent the next forty-six winters doing it again, photographing more than five thousand crystals. Every one had six-fold symmetry.
In November 1931, McGraw-Hill published Snow Crystals, with more than 2,400 of his photographs. His father had thought the camera a waste of money, and bought it anyway.
